QUOTE: "Calls `client.createPost` again. This call does not set `noRetry`, so the client's default retry policy applies to it." and "On failure, sets `failed: true` again. The same server errors that remove a post in `createPost` also remove it here."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer covers the failure handling (marks failed again, removes for the same errors) but never says the retry is a single attempt with no loop or backoff; it instead says the client's default retry policy applies, which contradicts "no backoff".
